name: s2n-tls
description_en: An implementation of the TLS/SSL protocols
readme_excerpt: s2n-tls is a C99 implementation of the TLS/SSL protocols that is designed to be simple, small, fast, and with security as a priority. It is released and licensed under the Apache License 2.0. > s2n-tls is short for "signal to noise" and is a nod to the almost magical act of encryption — disguising meaningful signals, like your critical data, as seemingly random noise. > -- s2n-tls announcement Quickstart for Ubuntu See the s2n-tls build documentation for further guidance on building s2n-tls for…
